set.body: Outcome: complete authorized items 1-5: execute detached retained fits; larger synthetic workload timing/RSS qualification; cancellable progress-aware latest-request viewer; derive first-level requirements from richer group consumers; consolidate a reproducible local source revision. Preserve numerical providers and scientific policies, no publication. Scope session/analysis, viewer protocol, group adapter and qualification/docs. Independent analytic/reference checks, resident/detached parity, explicit reload on design change, async cancellation/stale suppression tests, real browser path, repeated larger workload wall/RSS measurements and clean-checkout qualification. Use only synthetic data. Shared workspace source must be reviewed and checkpointed explicitly; never remove unrelated data or other actors build output. Disk currently 10GiB: reuse incremental target; no full build below20GiB. Next: reserve paths and delegate distinct adapter/viewer work while parent owns detached core and integration.
set.title: Complete cohort execution, interactive integration and reproducible qualification
